patterns: Amir Khusrau dominates: titles (Tuti-i-Hind), tabla/sitar, Sabak-i-Hindi, first Urdu/Khari Boli poet, birthplace Patiyali, works list (all four his).
Book-author pairs and 'not correctly matched' items (Tughluqnama-Ibn Battuta trap; Tarikh-i-Firoz Shahi by Afif/Barani).
Chronological ordering of texts (Kitab-ul-Hind, Prithviraj Raso, Tabaqat-i-Nasiri, Fatawa-i-Jahandari) asked by UPPSC.
Translations (Tutinama by Nakhshabi) and music treatises appear in UPPSC; App adds Telugu/Qutb Shahi literary angle that PYQs here do not test.
